On which devices can you deploy Endpoint Privilege Management (EPM)?

options.text: Create an Azure AD group that has dynamic membership rules and uses the ZTDID tag.
Create an Azure AD group that has dynamic membership rules and uses the operatingSystem tag.
Assign a Windows Autopilot deployment profile to a group.
Join the computers to Azure AD.
Create a Group Policy object (GPO) that is linked to a domain.
Join the computers to an on-premises Active Directory domain.

questions.explanation:
A dynamic Azure AD device group whose membership rule matches the `[ZTDId]` device physical-ID tag automatically includes all Windows Autopilot devices. Assigning a Windows Autopilot deployment profile to that group targets the identical profile to every member.

**Learn more:** [Create device groups for Windows Autopilot](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/autopilot/enrollment-autopilot) · [Configure Windows Autopilot profiles](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/autopilot/profiles)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have an Azure AD group called Group1. Group1 includes two Windows 10 Enterprise devices named Device1 and Device2.  
  
You create a device configuration profile called Profile1 and assign Profile1 to Group1.  
  
You need to ensure that Profile1 is applied only to Device1.  
  
What should you change in Profile1?
questions.explanation:
Device configuration profiles are deployed to the user or device groups specified in their assignments. To apply a profile only to Device1, narrow its assignment to a device group that contains Device1 but not Device2. Scope tags are for RBAC visibility, while Windows applicability rules evaluate OS edition or OS version rather than a specific device.

**Learn more:** [Assign policies in Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-configuration/assign-device-profile) · [Create a device configuration profile in Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/device-configuration/create-device-profile)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
You use app protection policies to safeguard corporate data on Android devices.  
  
You need to ensure that every user who connects from an Android device can access corporate data only when connecting through an app that supports mobile application management (MAM).  
  
What should you configure?
questions.explanation:
A Microsoft Entra Conditional Access policy can enforce app-based access controls, including requiring an approved client app or an app protection policy. This gates access to corporate Microsoft 365 resources so that Android clients must be MAM-capable and subject to the required app-protection controls. App protection policies define data-protection settings inside supported apps; they do not independently control sign-in access from unsupported apps.

**Learn more:** [Build Conditional Access policies in Microsoft Entra](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/conditional-access/concept-conditional-access-policies) · [Use Conditional Access with Microsoft Intune compliance policies](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/intune-service/protect/conditional-access-intune-common-ways-use)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your network has an Active Directory domain containing 10 computers that run Windows 10. Finance department users use these computers.  
  
You have a Windows 10 computer named Computer1.  
  
From Computer1, you plan to run a script that executes Windows PowerShell commands on the finance department computers.  
  
You need to ensure that PowerShell commands can be run on the finance department computers from Computer.  
  
What should you do on the finance department computers?

options.text: From Windows PowerShell, run the Enable-MMAgent cmdlet.
From the local Group Policy, enable the Allow Remote Shell Access setting.
From Windows PowerShell, run the Enable-PSRemoting cmdlet.
From the local Group Policy, enable the Turn on Script Execution setting.

questions.explanation:
`Enable-PSRemoting` configures a Windows computer to receive remote PowerShell commands through WS-Management, including enabling remoting session configurations and the required listener and firewall settings. It must be run on the target computers that will receive the commands.

**Learn more:** [Enable-PSRemoting (Microsoft.PowerShell.Core)](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/module/microsoft.powershell.core/enable-psremoting?view=powershell-7.6)

questions.question:
lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You have a Microsoft 365 tenant containing the objects shown in the following table.

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],You are replacing 100 Windows devices owned by the company.  
  
You must use the Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT) to securely wipe and decommission the devices. The solution must meet these requirements:

- Minimize administrative effort.  
  
Which task sequence template should you use?
questions.explanation:

You implement hybrid Azure AD and Microsoft Intune.  
  
You need to automatically register all existing computers with Azure AD and enroll them in Intune. The solution must minimize administrative effort.  
  
What should you use?
questions.explanation:

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your organization uses Microsoft Intune.  
  
More than 500 Android and iOS devices are enrolled in the Intune tenant.  
  
You plan to deploy new Intune policies. Different policies will apply according to the Android or iOS version installed on each device.  
  
You need to ensure that the policies can target devices based on their Android or iOS version.  
  
What should you configure first?

options.text: groups that have dynamic membership rules in Azure AD

questions.explanation:
Intune policy assignments target Microsoft Entra ID groups. Dynamic device groups can evaluate device attributes, including the operating-system version, so devices can be added automatically to the appropriate group and receive the corresponding policy.

**Learn more:** [Add groups to organize users and devices for Microsoft Intune](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/intune/fundamentals/tenant-administration/add-groups) · [Manage rules for dynamic membership groups in Microsoft Entra ID](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/entra/identity/users/groups-dynamic-membership)

lassName":"button hollow icon-accent icon-only question-actions"}],Your company has a Microsoft 365 subscription.  
  
All finance department users have personally owned devices running iOS or Android. Every device is enrolled in Microsoft Intune.  
  
The finance department adds new users each month.  
  
The company develops a mobile application named App1 for finance department users.  
  
You need to ensure that only finance department users can download App1.  
  
What should you do first?

options.text: Add App1 to the vendor stores for iOS and Android applications.
Add App1 to a Microsoft Deployment Toolkit (MDT) deployment share.

questions.explanation:

You have computers running Windows 11 Pro. The computers are joined to Azure AD and enrolled in Microsoft Intune.  
  
You need to upgrade the computers to Windows 11 Enterprise.  
  
What should you configure in Intune?
questions.explanation:
Intune performs Windows edition upgrades by deploying an **Edition upgrade and mode switch** device configuration profile. The profile specifies the target Windows edition and the product key or licensing information needed for the upgrade.\
\
**Learn more:** [Upgrade Windows editions or switch S mode using Intune policy](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-gb/mem/intune/configuration/edition-upgrade-configure-windows-10)

Which devices support Device query?

You plan to use Windows Autopilot to provision 25 devices running Windows 11.
